sections.heading: Crafting handoff
sections.body: For the tutorial, simply reaching Crafting is enough. The quest grants a Tutorial Sword, Tutorial Chest, and Tutorial Ring so you can learn equipment without needing to craft under pressure.

sections.heading: What to look at
sections.body: The recipe list shows what you can craft later. The detail panel shows output, tier, quantity, and required materials. The tutorial items are weaker than real crafted gear, so Crafting remains valuable afterward.

sections.heading: Next step
sections.body: After the tutorial gear appears in your inventory, go to Inventory and equip one piece to complete First Steps.
